$comment: Bindings additionally enforce UTF-8 byte bounds and the record bounds: 16 KiB per request, 128 KiB per result or notice. The conformance corpora name the capability, result and notice definitions of each operation.

identity.description: A nonzero 128-bit identity in lowercase hexadecimal.

requestId.title: RequestId
requestId.description: A mutation's identity; a repeated one returns the recorded outcome.

counter.description: An unsigned 64-bit value in canonical decimal.

transfer.title: TransferId
transfer.description: A Client-chosen transfer identity, nonzero and unique in the connection; Put and Chunk records carry it as u64.

pageCursor.description: An opaque continuation the previous page returned.

mtimeMs.description: Modification time in whole milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

path.title: FilePath
path.description: An absolute path in the machine's native form: at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL. orchbee-files refuses relative, dot, empty-segment, device, verbatim and UNC forms.

encoding.description: A VS Code encoding identifier such as `utf8`, `utf16le` or `windows1252`.

commit.description: A full object name: SHA-1 or SHA-256 in lowercase hexadecimal.

gitName.description: A remote or branch name: at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL, never starting with `-`.

token.description: An open kebab-case token; a Client treats one it does not know as absent.

search.title: SearchId
search.description: A Client-chosen text search identity under `files-search`, nonzero and unique in the connection.

cache.title: CacheId
cache.description: A Client-chosen Quick Open file list identity under `files-search`, nonzero and unique in the connection, as VS Code's `cacheKey` names one.

searchGlob.description: A glob relative to each searched folder; an exclude starting with `!` is an exception, whose files are searched even where an exclude or an ignore file hides them.

session.title: SessionId
session.description: A Client-chosen import, export or picker session under `files-edit`, nonzero and unique in the connection.

stash.title: StashId
stash.description: The undo stash a capturing `fs.delete` filled.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest in lowercase hexadecimal.

name.title: FileName
name.description: One path segment: at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes, neither `.` nor `..`, no `/` or NUL. orchbee-files refuses a name the machine cannot hold with `invalid-name`.

relativePath.title: RelativePath
relativePath.description: A path below a directory: names joined by `/`, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes.

conflict.description: What happens where a target exists: `fail` answers `exists`, `replace` removes the existing item permanently first, `increment` takes VS Code's next free `copy` name, and `merge` combines a directory with an existing directory, each child by the same rule, and replaces anything else.

name.description: The final component; empty for a filesystem root.

unrepresentable.description: The name is not valid UTF-8; `name` is a lossy spelling and the entry cannot be operated on. Absent means false.

error.description: An operation's failure. `reason` says why the service is unavailable and comes exactly with `unavailable`.

gitErrorCode.description: VS Code's GitErrorCodes name in kebab-case, such as `repository-is-locked`.

detail.description: Content Orchbee did not author, such as git's standard error, shown verbatim.

gitErrorCode.description: VS Code's GitErrorCodes name in kebab-case, such as `repository-is-locked`.

detail.description: Content Orchbee did not author, such as git's standard error, shown verbatim.

singleChild.description: Also list the chain of single-child directories below `path`. Absent means false.

source.description: `quick-open` states exactly one path the user typed in Quick Open, which may lie outside the scope; it needs `files-search`.

fsGrantRequest.description: `save-as` needs `files-edit`: the destination a Save As picker or dialog chose, anywhere on the machine and possibly not yet existing, which then counts as an opened file.

fsReadRequest.description: Reads `path`, the file entry `index` of an open export, or the Local History entry `history` of `path`.

export.description: The open export whose file entry `index` is read, under `files-edit`.

history.description: The Local History entry of `path` whose content is read, under `files-history`.

forceText.description: Decode a binary file as text. Absent means false.

limit.description: The largest file the Client accepts, in bytes; a larger one is `too-large`.

offset.description: Where the chunk starts: in decoded UTF-8 output bytes for a text read, in file bytes otherwise.

gitStageContentRequest.description: The index content follows as Put records of `transfer`, the last flagged `commit`.

gitCommitRequest.description: The message is `message`, or, with `editor: true`, asked through the relay's editor prompt.

gitFetchRequest.description: Fetches `remote`, every remote with `all: true`, or else the branch's default remote.

background.description: An automatic fetch, which never prompts.
An automatic fetch, which never prompts.

relayAnswerRequest.description: Answers `value`, nothing when absent, or cancels the operation with `cancelled: true`.

writePrecondition.description: What the file must be for the write to replace it: the version the editor last read or wrote, whose SHA-256 the content must still have unless it already holds the new content; `create`, no file at the path; or `none`, whatever is there.

fsWriteRequest.description: The new content follows as Put records of `transfer`: `size` bytes of UTF-8 text, the last flagged `commit`.

size.description: The UTF-8 bytes the Puts carry.

bom.description: Start a UTF-8 file with a byte order mark; UTF-16 always starts with one and other encodings never do. Absent means false.

unlock.description: Clear the file's read-only attribute or owner write bit before writing. Absent means false.

history.description: Why the content is written, which Local History records.

capture.description: First keep the folders and the files of at most 5,000,000 bytes in an undo stash. Absent means false.

fsClipboardRequest.description: Replaces the items the connection's clipboard holds; no paths clears it.

cut.description: The items were cut, so a paste may move them. Absent means false.

importItem.description: One item an import brings: a file of `size` bytes, or a directory, created when declared. Items are numbered from 0 across the import; an item of several names lies in a directory item declared earlier.

fsImportFileRequest.description: The file item's bytes follow as Put records of `transfer`, the last flagged `commit`.

pickerListRequest.description: Lists any directory of the machine for an open picker.

searchFolder.description: A folder a text search reads; it may lie outside the scope when the user typed it as an include.

includes.description: Globs its files must match beside the search's own.

matchLines.description: Lines of a match to preview; with 1, a preview is one line cut around its matches.

charsPerLine.description: UTF-16 code units a one-line preview keeps after each match's start.

pattern.description: What to find: literal text, or a JavaScript regular expression with `regex`.

encoding.description: The encoding of the files to search; absent means UTF-8.

maxResults.description: The most match ranges to report.

context.description: Lines of context before and after each match; absent means none.

query.description: What the user typed; empty only makes the list.

historyEntryId.title: HistoryEntryId
historyEntryId.description: A Local History entry, which orchbee-files chooses when it records it.

historyLabel.description: A Local History entry's name: at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL.

logPattern.description: A pattern `git.log` matches: at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL.

gitMessage.description: A stash or tag message: at most 16 KiB of UTF-8, no NUL.

gitLogRequest.description: One page of commits, in topological order when it walks named revisions or every reference, else in Git's default order.

revisions.description: The revisions to walk from; absent walks HEAD unless `all` holds.

all.description: Also walk every branch, remote branch and tag. Absent means false.

path.description: List only the commits that change this file or folder of the repository; its toplevel lists every commit.

follow.description: Follow the file at `path` through renames and report its path in each commit; orchbee-files refuses it without a file. Absent means false.

author.description: List only the commits whose author matches.

grep.description: List only the commits whose message matches this extended regular expression, ignoring case.

statistics.description: Report how many files and lines each commit changed. Absent means false.

limit.description: The most commits the page holds; fewer when they would pass the Result bound.

gitBlameRequest.description: One page of the commits that last changed each line of `path`; each page blames afresh.

commit.description: The commit whose version is blamed; absent blames the working tree.

ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore whitespace changes. Absent means false.

from.description: The earlier commit, whose merge base with `to` the changes start from; absent lists everything `to` holds.

name.description: The current branch's new name, the tag, or the remote.
The branch or tag without its `refs/heads/` or `refs/tags/` prefix.

revision.description: A branch, a remote branch or a commit.

detached.description: Check out its commit with HEAD detached. Absent means false.

track.description: Create a local branch that tracks the remote branch `revision` names. Absent means false.

start.description: The revision the branch starts at; absent starts it at HEAD.

checkout.description: Check the branch out. Absent means false.

force.description: Delete the branch even when it is not merged. Absent means false.

upstream.description: The remote branch it tracks from now on, such as `origin/main`.

commit.description: The commit HEAD must still name; another is `stale-revision`.

untracked.description: Also stash untracked files. Absent means false.

staged.description: Stash only the staged changes. Absent means false.

commit.description: The commit the entry must still be; another is `stale-revision`.

staged.description: Restore the staged changes as staged. Absent means false.

commit.description: The commit the entry must still be; another is `stale-revision`.

message.description: The message of an annotated tag; absent creates a lightweight one.

target.description: The revision the tag names; absent names HEAD.

url.description: The remote's URL, which never starts with `-`.

picker.description: The picker `parent` was chosen in, which the connection holds open in the Workspace.

parent.description: The folder the clone's own folder is created in.

url.description: The repository to clone, as Git reads it: a URL or a path, which never starts with `-`.

recursive.description: Also clone its submodules. Absent means false.

historyRestoreRequest.description: Copies the entry's content over `path`, then records the restore.

historyDeleteRequest.description: Deletes `entries` of `path`, or every entry with `all`.

entries.description: Entries of `path`; one already gone is skipped.

all.description: Delete every entry of every file. Absent means false.

request.description: A File Bar Request record's JSON body.

fsGrantResult.description: `entry` is absent only for a Save As destination that does not exist yet.

encoding.description: The encoding text chunks were decoded from; null for a byte read or an undecoded binary file.

remotes.description: Every remote on the first page; empty on later pages.

text.description: Command lines and output from the cursor on, as the ring holds them.

dropped.description: Bytes the ring overwrote between the requested cursor and `text`.

pathItemsResult.description: `git.clean` and `fs.restore`: one answer per path, with why it failed.

mutationReply.description: A mutation's recorded result, in any shape a mutation answers with; the requester knows which operation it named.

replaced.description: The characters the encoding cannot represent, each written as `?`, or as `??` beyond the Basic Multilingual Plane in a single-byte encoding, as VS Code writes them.

sha256.description: The digest of the written bytes, the precondition of the next save.

fsEntryResult.description: `fs.create` and `fs.rename`: the item's entry at its new path.

fsTransferResult.description: `fs.move` and `fs.copy`: one answer per source, in request order.

items.description: The item's final path, or why it failed; both when a move across volumes copied it but could not remove the source.

fsDeleteResult.description: One answer per path, in request order, and the undo stash when the delete captured something.

importOutcome.description: How a directory item ended when it was declared: its final path below the target directory, or why it failed.

fsImportResult.description: `fs.import-begin` and `fs.import-items`: one outcome per directory item the request declared, in request order.

fsImportFileResult.description: The file's final path below the target directory.

exportEntry.description: One entry of an export, numbered in order, each directory before what it holds; `skipped` marks an entry the export does not take: a link to a directory, which it never enters, a link whose target leaves the boundary, or an entry it could not read or that is neither a file nor a directory.

pickerOpenResult.description: The user's home directory and the machine's filesystem roots.

searchSpan.description: `[startLine, startColumn, endLine, endColumn]` from 0, columns in UTF-16 code units, the end exclusive.

searchMatch.description: A matched line, or the lines one match spans; a line's ranges may arrive in more than one match, each with the same preview.

searchFile.description: Results in one file; a file's results may span consecutive entries and batches, in order.

done.description: The search ended: this is its last batch.

omittedLongLines.description: Matched and context lines left out so far because they are too long to carry.

symlinkLoops.description: Folders searched again without following symbolic links, which form too many loops in them, each reported once.

searchHighlights.description: Matched `[start, end]` ranges in UTF-16 code units, the end exclusive.

score.description: VS Code's fuzzy score of the path relative to its folder.

truncated.description: The file list stopped at its bound, so some files are missing from it.

limitHit.description: More files matched than `maxResults`, or than one result carries.

timeMs.description: A time in whole milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

refs.description: The references at the commit as Git decorates them in full, such as `HEAD -> refs/heads/main` and `tag: refs/tags/v1`.

message.description: The raw message without its last line end.

messageCut.description: The message was longer and is cut. Absent means false.

statistics.description: What the commit changed, when the request asked; a merge's are its first parent's diff.

path.description: The followed file's path in this commit.

commit.description: The commit; the all-zero name holds the lines no commit holds.

summary.description: The first line of its message.

commits.description: Each commit the page's ranges name, once.

path.description: The path in the later commit; a deleted path's in the earlier one.

original.description: A renamed path's path in the earlier commit.

insertions.description: Lines added; absent for a binary file.

deletions.description: Lines removed; absent for a binary file.

commit.description: The merge base; absent when the histories never meet.

branch.description: The branch the stash was taken on.

description.description: Its message, or HEAD's commit and subject when it was taken without one.

wip.description: It was taken without a message. Absent means false.

source.description: How the entry came to be: a save, a restore, a move to another folder, or a rename in its folder.

timestamp.description: When the file had this content.

directory.description: The item is or was a directory, as far as the watcher knows.

repository.description: The repository whose operation asks; for `git.clone`, the folder the clone fills.
